chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vantung ah kihilna lim a thupi a lamdang dang khat ka mu hi. Gimpinaa sagih a nei vanmi sagih om a, tua gimpinate tawh Pasian' lungsona kicing ta ahih manin tuate a tawpna ahi hi.

Tua ciangin meikuang a kihel, limlang tuipi bang khat ka mu a, tua banah sapi tungah ahi zongin, a milim leh a min nambat tungah ahi zongin, a gualzo khinte pen a khut uhah Pasian' harp khausaite tawi-in limlang tuipi gei-ah ding uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' sila Moses' la, Tuuno la, hih bangin sa uh hi: “Na sepkhiatte thupi-in lamdang hi, Vanglian Topa Pasian aw! Na sepziate thutangin thumaan hi, minamte' Kumpi aw!

Topa aw, kua in nang hong kihta lo-in na min hong sangkhan lo ding ahi hiam? A hang pen nang bek na siangtho hi. Minam khempeuh hong pai-in nang hong bia ding uh hi. A hang pen nangma' diktatna kilang khinzo hi.”
Tua khitzawh ka khuadak leh vantunga teci panna puanbuk biakinnpi kihong hi.
Gimpina sagih a nei vanmi sagihte biakinnpi pan hong pusuak uh a, puannel a paak leh a siang silhin a awm uhah kham awmdal vial uh hi.
Sahing lite lakah khat in a tawntung a tawntungin a nungta Pasian' lungsona tawh a kidim kham kuang-uk khat vanmi sagihte' tungah pia hi.
Tua ciangin biakinnpi pen Pasian' minphatna leh ama' vangliatna pana hong pai meikhu tawh kidim a, vanmi sagihte' neih gimpina sagih a man mateng biakinnpi sung a lut thei kuamah om lo hi.
